source.title: Randstad Holding - Wikipedia
source.quote: In September 2011, Randstad acquired Spherion for $770 million.

source.title: Randstad Holding - Wikipedia
source.quote: In 2008, Randstad acquired Vedior for €3.3 billion and scaled up across Europe.

source.title: Randstad Holding - Wikipedia
source.quote: In 2024, Randstad acquired Torc, an AI-powered talent marketplace, to enhance its digital engineering delivery.
